name: 文脉本地文章工厂 MCP

portableAccessFile.serverAuthority: agent_clients status, expiry and revocation are authoritative
portableAccessFile.credentialExposure: never URL, argv, logs or connectionCard
portableAccessFile.storage: treat as an SSH private key; POSIX 0600 where supported

roleAccess.taskManagerBoundary: server-authoritative task.manage plus the matching action snapshot is required; content-steward is the default portable role, while advanced exact grants may also qualify
roleAccess.developmentAndUpgrade: local Git, worktree, tests and review only; never use a Bearer role grant
currentGaps: no safe Agent write API for deduplication final merge
no safe Agent write API for workflow fission new roots

implementation.tokenEnvironmentUsage: internal child-process injection only; do not persist plaintext in MCP configuration
implementation.tokenSource: 在 Agent 中心的权限与 Key 面板由所有者手工签发，再保存为 Windows DPAPI CurrentUser 命名档案
implementation.privilegedRoleProfiles: not exposed as generic MCP tools; administrator task actions use the separate AdminAction wrapper and local super-admin actions, including create_publication_branch, attach_branch and register_publication_version, remain per-route allowlisted
implementation.siteFullControlKey: v5 site.full_control Key is accepted as an Agent Bearer by Codex, QwenPaw and this MCP server at exact http://[::1]:3000; purpose=site_full_control, actionIds auth.site_full_control.direct + auth.site_full_control.exchange, role=super_admin, all articles including future additions, taskIds=[], root lifetime 1..7 days. The root authorization includes token.issue/token.revoke through the Agent API, although the stock MCP tool list does not expose generic Key-management tools. It may optionally exchange for a host-only browser management cookie, but it never grants publish.capability.consume, external login, or the final publish click.

packageTools.readTransport: GET /api/agent/v1 project_* views with Agent Bearer

projectGroupTools.readTransport: GET /api/agent/v1 project_group* views with Agent Bearer only
projectGroupTools.completeGroupScopeGate: every group member articleId must be authorized; MCP never receives a redacted topology
projectGroupTools.emptyGroupScope: star-scoped tokens may read empty groups; restricted tokens omit them and receive 403 on detail without disclosure

sharedSourceTools.reason: MCP has not registered shared-source tools; this is not a claim that a connector, remote synchronization, or source content read is available.
sharedSourceTools.projectionIfFutureToolIsRegistered: No shared-source MCP tool is registered. The current Agent API exposes only 0031 metadata projection after source, current binding, rights and access gates; excludes body, excerpt, content_ref and raw provider IDs.

writeContract.candidateHandoff: progress checkpoint followed by wenmai_ask_human or coordinator handoff

privilegedPublicationBranchControl.issuanceStatus: The listed publication-branch controls are safe current v3 catalog scopes only when selected by an owner from the permission catalog; this MCP server does not expose them as generic tools. High-risk issuance remains disabled.
privilegedPublicationBranchControl.sourceBoundary: create_publication_branch accepts only the current clean primary/canonical Package coordinates with Package, branch, Revision, body and Composition CAS
privilegedPublicationBranchControl.historicalContentFlow: worker branch-qualified candidate Patch -> legacy local super_admin decide_patch -> legacy local super_admin apply_patch -> register_publication_version; decide/apply are not available for new v3 issuance

workspaceBranchWriteV3.issuance: current v3 new issuance only when selected from the owner permission catalog

taskManageV3.agentBranchCreation: create_task may create a task-owned Agent Branch, initial Revision and WorkingCopy only when branch.agent_write is explicitly requested.

boundaries.keyIssueOrRevoke: ordinary MCP Agent tools: false; v5 site.full_control raw Agent API authorization: true

permissionCatalogV5.access: owner browser management session only; Bearer Agent tokens cannot read it
permissionCatalogV5.catalogDigest: GET includes catalogSha256, the canonical SHA-256 of the complete catalog and presets. Current catalog version is 2026-09-10.1.
permissionCatalogV5.issuanceConfirmation: v3 issuance echoes catalogVersion, catalogSha256 and sorted deduplicated confirmedActionIds; the server recomputes the digest and exact scope-to-action set. Read-only presets use confirmedActionIds=[].
permissionCatalogV5.legacyV3WithoutDigest: compatibility-only and never automatically expanded by later catalog changes
permissionCatalogV5.mcpRole: The stock MCP tool list consumes a separately issued Key and does not expose generic issue/revoke/catalog tools; a v5 site.full_control holder may use the documented raw Agent API token.issue/token.revoke routes at exact [::1].
permissionCatalogV5.v5KeyBoundary: Ordinary Keys use sorted 1..200 concrete articleIds and taskIds=[]; v5 site.full_control is the sole all-article scope, includes future articles, has purpose=site_full_control and root lifetime 1..7 days. All Key lifetimes are free integers from 1 through the role maximum.
permissionCatalogV5.highRiskActivation: Internal high-risk scopes may now be newly issued through free selection or the separation/conflict presets, with server-side role, action and lifetime checks. publish.capability.consume remains newIssuance=false and cannot be delegated. This is a static catalog/contract statement, not proof of a real D1 migration, Key, action, external publication, or layered claim.
permissionCatalogV5.legacyAndLocalImport: Legacy privileged Keys remain frozen compatibility records. v4 management_session_exchange Keys only exchange and require reissuance for v5 direct use. Historical publish.capability.consume routes to /api/publish-capability/v1 action=consume and remains newIssuance=false. Ordinary Worker/Candidate issuance remains separate; local-import remains the exclusive article.import.new_root scope with articleIds=['*'] and taskIds=[].
